276 E 149th St.opinion: Good Cheap pizza to eat during my lunch break from work. It was just perfect it was like a old pizza spot from Harlem. compared to the other place near here it was much better.

253 E 149th St.opinion: HORRIBLE BAD DEFINITION OF BAD CHEAP. The pizza felt and tasted like cardboard and it looked bad after it wasn't hot anymore

415 2nd Ave.opinion: Overpriced and not good. Place has gone through 2 renovations on the entire time i've taken this route for my braces not worth.

316 W 39th St.opinion: Decent pizza kinda expensive but very convenient it being right near Port Authority, Which i use to take the bus up and down from Rochester to NYC.

150 E 116th St.opinion: THE BEST TASTIEST PIZZA EVER. Kinda pricey but the slices are big so its worth the money. Most authentic and best pizza i've ever had plus i've had it for many years.

1875 Lexington Ave.opinion: It used to taste like the one from the bronx that i liked before and my mom used to love it. But to stay cheap it just doesn't taste good anymore. Not to mention sometimes the bottom is burnt a bit sometimes. A old memory of something that was good.

153 E 116th St.opinion: When can dominos ever go wrong. Pizza's always good but a difference from the other Dominos pick, This dominos store makes better garlic bread than the other location.

200 E 116th St.opinion: This pizza place has been there for years even with all the other pizzarias around it has yet to be shut down because of its prices. It might not be good at all like that but in East Harlem where there's alot of homeless or poor people this ends up thriving.

2255 2nd Ave.opinion: Another old spot that has been around for many years without closing. Only been to this spot like once or twice. I remember it being decent but thats all there was to it, still in a good location with decent customers.

2287 1st Ave.opinion: Another good decent pizzaria. The location is immaculate because its near plaza with no other pizza stores in the immediate location to contest it.

517 E 117th St.opinion: Costco's pizza after being forced by my parents to be there as a end after being hungry the entire time just hits differently. even though its not like crazy it still just hits because of the hunger.

1993 3rd Ave.opinion: Again dominos can never go wrong but this location has better pizza pies than the one in the other location. It just hits a bit differently.

1936 3rd Ave.opinion: Little Caesars just hits when the times is right. As well as the pizza breads just be very good with the garlic taste. Alway's good no matter what since its just different from the other pizza locations.

1850 3rd Ave.opinion: was not really that good its just a store thats there at this point. I be surprised its still in open and not closed down.

1590 Lexington Ave.opinion: Pretty good. the fact it was near my highschool on the way to the train station made it just a good place to get quick food from. pretty good area too.

2146 2nd Ave.opinion: A old spot i used to go to many times when i lived closer to it. But at one point it just didn't taste the same as before and the other one was just better and closer. So i ended up dropping this one but it still holds a special part in my heart.
